raw_response:
I am 65 years old and have farmed this land in Quzhou for 40 years. I know every plot. My family has seven mouths to feed, and some of my children work off-farm, so I cannot waste labor on crops that are not reliable. With 20.4 mu and a well for irrigation, I will stick to what works.

**Wheat-maize rotation on 16 mu:** This is my bread and butter. In early October I will rotary-till the 16 mu and sow improved wheat—about 30 jin per mu. I will put down compound fertilizer as a basal dose and topdress with urea at green-up and jointing. Over the season that comes to about 25 kg of nitrogen, 10 kg of phosphorus, and 4 kg of potassium per mu. Because I have the well, I will irrigate four times: winter irrigation to protect against the cold, then at jointing, heading, and grain filling. I will spray four times total—herbicide once and insecticide/fungicide as needed. I expect around 1,000 kg per mu if the weather holds.

After wheat harvest in early June, there is no time to waste. I will no-till plant hybrid maize the same week—Denghai or Nongda, about one package per mu. Maize needs less phosphorus and potassium than wheat but still wants nitrogen, so I will apply compound at sowing and side-dress urea at the big-flare stage. That gives roughly 18 kg nitrogen, 5 kg phosphorus, and 3 kg potassium per mu. I will irrigate twice, at tasseling and grain filling, and spray four times for weeds, borers, and any leaf blight that appears. I have gotten 1,100 kg per mu from this plot before and expect about the same.

**Millet on 4.4 mu:** The remaining 4.4 mu I will plant to improved millet in late spring. Millet does not need as much water or fertilizer, and my family likes millet porridge. I will rotary-till once and sow about 1 jin per mu. I will spread a modest amount of compound fertilizer at sowing—about 6 kg nitrogen, 3 kg phosphorus, and 2 kg potassium per mu—and irrigate once, maybe twice if the summer turns dry. Two pesticide sprays will be enough. I expect about 350 kg per mu from this patch, some for home and some to sell at the village market.
